objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, and reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected type such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name composed from abbreviation, consecutive number, and title by default.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment for reader authorization.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person assigned for translation release handling.

attributes.name: distribution_by_e_mail
attributes.description: User groups or persons informed by e-mail on release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons requested to confirm acknowledgement on release.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after invalidation before physical deletion.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification used when creating and managing documents, with templates, abbreviations, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the default document name.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity review is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main document release cycle or its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document associated with a main document and automatically released with it.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document without initially affecting the document content or version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to check and extend validity.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document and archive it.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to revalidate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in authoring, reviewing, releasing, reading, acknowledging, translating, or administering documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, roles, distribution, reader access, archive access, and reactivation permission.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release-process tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by distribution recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail sent by the system to inform users about workflow tasks, document release, change proposals, validity extension, override, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Link between a document and master data, another document, or other referenced objects.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: A document template is selected when creating a new document object.

evts.name: edit_properties
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained in categories.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: A document is saved after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF and displayed on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group-related and person-related authorizations are assigned in the document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released and published directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An attachment associated with a document is changed.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The three-step release process is initiated by an author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete their review task positively or reject it.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete their release task positively or reject it.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: The workflow is canceled after a rejection during review or release with multiple users.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a document is created due to revision-triggering changes or reactivation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The document author documents the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A completed change proposal is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared, the request is deleted, and the document valid until date is updated.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A document needing revision is updated in a new version.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension process is automatically terminated when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing an override request starts automatically.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document and its attachments are declared invalid and archived.

evts.name: revoke_rights
evts.description: All rights except for the archive group are revoked for an archived document.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A reactivation request is created and the document for reactivation is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for reactivation starts automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with a document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists are maintained by assigning user groups or persons to a document.

evts.name: send_release_e_mail
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document version.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_complete
evts.description: The author team is notified when all persons in the distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Visibility of a document in clients is specified.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: A reference is created between a local addition document and the original document or between documents and maintained referenced objects.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created based on a selected template.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with the main document version.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Users can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient for a document.
User groups are assigned to documents for reader access, authorizations, distribution, archive access, or visibility in dashboards.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned directly to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
Workflow tasks are assigned to workflow participants.
Document workflows create tasks for participants.
Workflow participants complete release tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released document version.
Acknowledgements are documented for document versions distributed for acknowledgement.
Recipients confirm acknowledgement.
Users involved in workflows or distribution receive e-mail notifications.
E-mail notifications inform users about document-related tasks, releases, or proposals.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
Documents can have references maintained through document properties or local additions.
A reference can link to another document, including an original document.
